headline: Battle Lines Shift at Stonecradle and Weathered
war_summary: Since the last edition, StonecradleHex has grown more turbulent, its twenty-four-hour base events rising from fourteen to seventeen, with three recorded in the latest two hours. The sector now stands at eight Colonial strategic bases to one Warden, making it the clearest active hinge on the map. WeatheredExpanseHex remains the war’s principal furnace: thirty-six events across twenty-four hours, four in the latest two, and casualties still heavy on both sides, though the recent rate has cooled. MooringCountyHex retains a nine-to-three Warden advantage, but its six-hour tally is active even as the latest two-hour window is silent. FarranacCoastHex has nine daily events yet no turnover in six hours, while FishermansRowHex records fourteen across the day but has likewise gone quiet recently. LinnMercyHex shows six daily events, with no fresh movement in two hours. Callahans Passage continues to report the heaviest sustained casualty traffic without any recorded base event, leaving its strategic effect uncertain.
